## Ready-to-use resources

- **5th-grade English grammar quiz:** [BrightSprout — *5th Grade Grammar Test: Sentences*](https://brightsprout.com/worksheet/5th-grade-grammar-test-sentences)
  - A printable, quick matching quiz/review covering nine sentence and grammar terms, including fragments, declarative/interrogative/imperative/exclamatory sentences, subject, and conjunction.
  - The page labels it for **5th grade** and offers **“View Worksheet”** to customize or download it.

- **8th-grade basic marketing worksheet:** [BrightSprout — *The 4 P’s of Marketing: Exit Ticket and Product Matrix*](https://brightsprout.com/worksheet/the-4-ps-of-marketing-exit-ticket-and-product-matrix)
  - This is specifically labeled for **8th grade**. It begins with three exit-ticket questions, then has students make a marketing matrix for a product using **product, price, place, and promotion**.
  - Select **“View Worksheet”** to edit it if desired and download/print it.

- **Fun shared Slidesgo template:** [Bloom Quiz](https://slidesgo.com/theme/bloom-quiz)
  - A colorful, interactive quiz-game template with pink/yellow gradients. Slidesgo says you can change the questions, themes, colors, and typography, and download it for **Google Slides** or PowerPoint. It should work nicely for a short grammar warm-up followed by 4 Ps questions.

## Intro in bionic reading

> **To**day we **will** **warm** up with a **short** **gram**mar **quiz**, then **prac**tice how **peo**ple use **ba**sic **mar**keting **stra**tegies like **pro**duct, **price**, **place**, and **pro**motion. **Read** each di**rec**tion **care**fully and do your **best**.
